title: Kissed Fluffy Tunisian Steak Tagine
description: A cultured and cozy Tunisian dish featuring sirloin steak tips, bonito flakes, and low glycemic ingredients, resulting in a fluffy and savory tagine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium high heat.
Add the sirloin steak tips and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the bonito flakes, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chopped dried apricots and chicken broth, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the steak is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve with cauliflower rice or low glycemic index sides.
